subject.title: fix(matrix): cross-signing bootstrap dead-ends on MAS-fronted Synapse with misleading matrix.password error

question: Should the Matrix bootstrap path expose the full MAS reset URL through its error contract, or must it use a deliberately redacted/operator-only presentation path before merge?
rationale: The URL is necessary for operator recovery but may contain a sensitive approval token; selecting the durable error and logging boundary requires maintainer ownership beyond a routine mechanical fix.

options.title: Require token-safe live proof
options.body: Keep the actionable recovery flow, but require a live MAS run and evidence that all emitted logs redact the URL token before merge.

options.title: Use a narrower recovery presentation
options.body: Change the error contract so normal logs provide a redacted URL or recovery instruction while an explicitly operator-facing surface handles the complete link.

recommendation.title: Require token-safe live proof
recommendation.body: Keep the actionable recovery flow, but require a live MAS run and evidence that all emitted logs redact the URL token before merge.
